title: 🕒 2026-10-13 | fix: restore Eleven v4 regular prices
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Restored regular Pollen pricing for ElevenLabs v4 and v4 Turbo speech generation, billed per 1,000 characters. Both models retain multiplier 1. Updated the effective-price test snapshots.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli checks two speech-wave displays labeled 'Eleven v4' and 'v4 Turbo' beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny headphones; she is small within the scene, in strictly pixel art style. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, a warm cream background, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
